nodes.title: First-Year Honors Seminar
nodes.description: This course introduces students to UC San Diego’s vibrant intellectual community through weekly seminars and field trips led by faculty and invited speakers. Students learn about the innovative research and other artistic and scientific endeavors taking place across campus and in the surrounding community.

nodes.title: Instructional Apprenticeship
nodes.description: Students, under the direction of the instructor, lead discussion sections, attend lectures, and meet regularly with the instructor to help prepare course materials.
